checklist.heading: Carpet Cleaning Checklist — Manchester
checklist.intro: What our carpet cleaners do on every carpet clean:

tasks: Move small items off the carpet
Thoroughly vacuum to lift loose dirt and dust
Check the carpet type and any problem areas
Pre-treat marks, spills and high-traffic areas
Remove as much moisture as possible
Clean each stair tread and riser
Pay extra attention to edges and corners
Give advice on drying and aftercare

whyMatters.heading: Why Professional Carpet Cleaning Is Worth It
body: Carpets trap dust, crumbs and everyday dirt deep in the fibres. Regular vacuuming lifts the surface, but the ground-in dirt that dulls carpets over time needs a deeper clean.
Professional carpet cleaning refreshes the whole carpet, brightening colours and tackling marks on busy walkways, stairs and landings.
It's especially worth it when you move: a fresh carpet helps a property feel cared for when it's handed back to a landlord or shown to new tenants.

faqs.q: How much does carpet cleaning cost in Manchester?
faqs.a: Carpets, stairs and upholstery each have a fixed price. The price list on this page comes straight from our booking system, so it always shows today's prices. The per-carpet price is for a minimum of 2 carpets.

faqs.q: How long do carpets take to dry?
faqs.a: It depends on the carpet, the room temperature and ventilation. Opening windows and keeping the heating on helps carpets dry faster.
We pre-treat marks and do everything we can, but some old or set-in stains may not come out completely. We'll let you know if a stain is likely to stay.

faqs.q: Can I add carpet cleaning to an end of tenancy clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Add carpet cleaning as an extra when you book your end of tenancy, deep or regular clean, or book it on its own.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
faqs.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.

faqs.q: Do you have carpet cleaners near me?
faqs.a: Our carpet cleaners cover Manchester and Greater Manchester, including Manchester City Centre, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Didsbury, Chorlton, Bolton, Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Tameside and Wigan.

faqs.q: Is your Carpet Cleaning method safe?
faqs.a: All of our carpet cleaning detergents and equipment are completely safe for children, pets and adults and are also non-toxic and non-hazardous.

faqs.q: Can I book on a weekend?
faqs.a: Yes, you can schedule our Carpet Cleaning Service 7 days a week at a time convenient for you, we also work Saturdays and Sundays.

faqs.q: I am not sure what the exact fabric of my carpet?
faqs.a: If you are not sure what the exact fabric of your carpet is when you are finalizing your carpet cleaning appointment you can always email us a photo of the carpet or our carpet cleaning technicians will advise you when they are on-site.

faqs.q: What carpet cleaning method do you use in Manchester?
faqs.a: Cleaniq Services uses hot water extraction. Marks and high-traffic areas are pre-treated first, then hot water extraction lifts the dirt that everyday vacuuming leaves behind.

faqs.q: Do you clean stairs, landings and upholstery as well as carpets?
faqs.a: Yes. Our carpet cleaners clean carpets, stairs, landings and upholstery. Each has a fixed price, shown live on this page from our booking system.
